_about: A living ASCII scene behind the home page header and profile, loaded by js/main.js (HERO BACKGROUND). Personal: setup.py deletes this file and capetown.js, keeping engine.js and the example. Delete this file to turn it off. timezone: the scene's clock (IANA name; leave out for the visitor's own); place: named in the time slider's label. focus_column/focus_row: the scene cell put at the profile photo's centre (here the Table's centre, on the horizon). zoom: below 1 zooms out (down to the whole scene across the width). photo_row: the scene starts right under the top bar and the profile (photo and bio) starts at this scene row (the horizon is row 64), so the Table shows above it; photo_row_wide overrides it above 720px; leave both out to centre the photo on the focus cell instead. footer_band: [first row, rows] of the scene echoed in the footer. footer_note: optional line above the caption. captions: [from hour, text] for the footer, in order. accents: [from hour, light-theme link colour, dark-theme link colour], the site's brand colour following the scene (deep purple late at night, pink at dawn, blue by day, teal in the south-easter, gold and orange at sunset, then maroon and purple; every colour and every blend between them AA-checked on the page and hover fills); the footer's time slider takes it too, blended between the hours.
footer_note: A slice of home · **Cape Town** · dynamic and beautiful
captions: A starry night over Table Mountain: the Milky Way and the Southern Cross.
Dawn: first light behind Table Mountain, watching the surfers paddle out.
Midday: the sun at its peak, a clear blue sky over the Table.
Afternoon: kitesurfers in the south-easter, the tablecloth on the Table.
Golden hour: the last kitesurfers in the golden light.
Sunset: the sky on fire over the Atlantic, the cormorants flying home.
Dusk: the city lights come on under Table Mountain.
A starry night over Table Mountain: the Milky Way and the Southern Cross.
